title: Witness compatibility for an inverse-image family
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and g : Y -> X any morphism. Let (A,I) be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The actual finite-coefficient derived pullback family along g satisfies PbcFamilyWitnessCompatibility of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility], including its natural quotient reductions, functorial transport of the retained etale origins, and the prescribed adjacent normalization equation. No properness or finiteness assumption on g is made.

source.place: step (b), pullbacks; repaired node proof step 4

proof.text: Cancel the two canonical coefficient-realization equivalences in the actual finite pullback, giving a natural isomorphism with exact termwise fixed-ring inverse image. The reverse scalar-adjunction mate scalarPullbackProEtaleIso, a constant-coefficient specialization of the tensor-pullback theorem, then gives the adjacent rho; restrict it to the stated full reduction domain.

Use the actual etale inverse image of each retained origin. Exact termwise descent preserves its lower bound. The derived comparison-pullback isomorphism, inverse image of the input alpha, and the coefficient coordinate isomorphism give its output comparison isomorphism. Applying realization yields the explicit retained pair.

Apply the generic witness-compatibility assembly theorem to these rho and actual bounded-below etale origins. Its full-faithful lifting proves the etale normalization, all three morphism equations, and the functor laws, with exactly the given finite-level functors.
